description:
Found by the fz-sc8.160 and fz-sc8.158 builders; reproduced on 2053b04a5.
Repro: IO.inspect(Enum.to_list(1..40))
Elixir prints two lines, breaking after "22," and indenting the second by one space. fz prints one 148-column line. Elixir IO.inspect and inspect/1 format through Inspect.Algebra with the default width 80; fz writes every value on one line.
Oracle fixtures currently dodge it by keeping printed collections under 80 columns (01143 prints through Enum.map_join, 01144 splits its lists). The distiller output on tests/distill_telemetry/main_returns_one.jsonl does not hit it. Related: fz-9un (Inspect options, including width: and pretty:); the default-width break is the part every program sees.
Done when: an oracle fixture inspects a list, a tuple, a map and a nested mix that each exceed 80 columns and matches Elixir on interp, run and build.
title: IO.inspect breaks a long collection across lines at 80 columns
